terms.definition: The depth below the ocean surface where temperature or density changes by a specified threshold relative to the surface reference value, characterizing the turbulent, well-mixed surface layer.
terms.source: de Boyer Montégut et al. (2004), J. Geophys. Res., 109, C12003
terms.formula: ΔT = 0.2 °C or Δσθ = 0.03 kg/m³ relative to 10 dbar reference

terms.definition: A measure of the integrated heat content of the upper ocean from the sea surface down to the depth of the 26 °C isotherm.
terms.source: Shay et al. (2000), Mon. Wea. Rev., 128, 1366–1383
terms.formula: TCHP = ρ * Cp * ∫ (T(z) - 26) dz from z(T=26°C) to 0

terms.definition: The Sound Fixing and Ranging channel axis corresponding to the oceanic depth where acoustic sound speed reaches a vertical minimum, acting as a deep sound waveguide.
terms.source: Ewing & Worzel (1948), Geol. Soc. Am. Mem., 27
